text.content:
Built the dam, drowned a town, sells the city water it can't drink.

Headquarters: Laguna Bend Dam
Industry: Water and hydroelectric power
In Night City: Laguna Bend Dam's turbines run; its water purification plant was never finished

In 2062 NC Dam Ltd flooded the valley behind Laguna Bend Dam, and the township of Laguna Bend with it. The company said everyone had been moved out. Lyle Thompson filmed a man on his roof as the water came up; Network 54 cut it.

The reservoir is toxic and will be for years, so the city drinks the sea, through desalination on the bay and the Wellsprings treatment plant. The dam's power plant runs behind NC Dam Ltd security.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 05, 13
